title: Language Bias under Conflicting Information in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Using a multilingual conflicting 'needles in a haystack' paradigm, where contradictory pieces of information (needles) are inserted into long contexts (haystacks) in different languages. Bias is evaluated by swapping the languages of the conflicting information in contrastive pairs and measuring which language's information the model preferentially retrieves.
